This video is intended for educational purposes only and is designed to support learning through observation of gait. There is no audio in this video.

Explore Mission Gait Foundation’s Gait Deviations Library: https://missiongait.org/gait-deviations-library/
Videos are organized by observable gait deviations and conditions to guide clinical observation and reasoning.
